title: How to make AI writing sound human, and like you
seoTitle: Make AI writing sound human and like you
description: Make AI writing sound human. Build a voice guide from your own writing, ban the common AI tells and run one edit pass prompt before anything goes out.
lede: To make AI writing sound human, give your AI samples of how you write and a list of habits to avoid. This guide shows how to turn your own writing into a one-page voice guide, which AI tells to ban, and the edit prompt to run before you publish.
